`final class DevFont`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.internal.font` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [DevFont.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/internal/font/DevFont.java)

The font of the dev tools, Montserrat in its nine weights, loaded at startup in dev mode only.

## Description

The inspector draws with it.
It is not in the prod jar, and JOID ships no production font: load a font of your own for your text.
